title: Calibration Protocol for OD600 to Colony Forming Units (CFUs)
author: Richard Tennant
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zgnf3ve
materials: You have now completed this calibration protocol

steps.title: Measure culture OD600
steps.instruction: Dilute each cell culture to the linear detection range of the plate reader and measure OD600. Example: add 25 µL culture to 175 µL LB + chloramphenicol (Cam) in a well of a black 96‑well plate (clear, flat bottom) so each well contains 200 µL total.

steps.title: Dilute culture to OD0.1
steps.instruction: Dilute each overnight culture to an OD600 of 0.1 in a final volume of 1 mL LB + Cam, preparing three replicates per culture. Use C1·V1 = C2·V2, where C1 is the blank‑corrected, dilution‑adjusted starting OD, C2 = 0.1, V2 = 1000 µL. Example calculation: C1 = (1:8 OD600 − blank) × 8 = (0.195 − 0.042) × 8 = 1.224. Then V1 = (0.1 × 1000 µL) / 1.224 ≈ 82 µL. Add 82 µL culture to 918 µL LB + Cam.

steps.title: Verify OD600 equals 0.1
steps.instruction: Re‑measure the OD600 of each diluted sample to confirm it is 0.1, using the same 200 µL well setup as in step 1.

steps.title: Prepare agar plates and dilution tubes
steps.instruction: For the serial dilutions you will need 3 LB‑agar + Cam plates per sample (total 36 plates). Prepare three 2.0 mL tubes per sample (total 36 tubes) each containing 1900 µL LB + Cam for Dilutions 1–3, and two 1.5 mL tubes per sample (total 24 tubes) each containing 900 µL LB + Cam for Dilutions 4–5.

steps.title: Label dilution tubes
steps.instruction: Label every tube with its dilution number (Dilution 1, Dilution 2, … Dilution 5) for each starting sample.

steps.title: Perform serial dilutions
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of the starting culture to the tube labeled Dilution 1, discard the tip, do NOT pipette up and down, then vortex the tube for 5–10 seconds. Repeat the transfer of 100 µL from the previous dilution to the next tube (Dilution 2, Dilution 3, Dilution 4, Dilution 5) using a fresh tip each time, vortexing each tube for 5–10 seconds.

substeps.instruction: Pipet 100 µL of starting culture into Dilution 1; discard tip; vortex 5–10 s.
Transfer 100 µL from Dilution 1 to Dilution 2; discard tip; vortex 5–10 s.
Transfer 100 µL from Dilution 2 to Dilution 3; discard tip; vortex 5–10 s.
Transfer 100 µL from Dilution 3 to Dilution 4; discard tip; vortex 5–10 s.
Transfer 100 µL from Dilution 4 to Dilution 5; discard tip; vortex 5–10 s.

steps.title: Plate diluted samples
steps.instruction: Aseptically spread 100 µL from Dilutions 3, 4, and 5 onto separate LB + Cam agar plates.

steps.title: Incubate plates
steps.instruction: Incubate the plated agar at 37 °C overnight and count colonies after 18–20 hours of growth.

steps.title: Count colonies
steps.instruction: For each plate that contains fewer than 300 colonies, count the number of colonies.

steps.title: Calculate CFU per mL
steps.instruction: Multiply the colony count by the final dilution factor for that plate to obtain CFU / mL for the original OD600 = 0.1 sample. Example (Dilution 4): 125 colonies × (8 × 10⁵) = 1 × 10⁸ CFU / mL.
